infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Kova talks to your home’s Kova hub on your Wi-Fi.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kova uses the camera to scan the code that connects it to your home.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kova uses your location to know when you arrive home and leave.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Kova watches a circle around your home, so the house knows when you arrive and leave even with the app closed. Your location stays on this phone.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kova uses the microphone only while you talk to Ask Kova, to turn what you say into text.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Kova uses Apple’s speech recognition to turn what you say to Ask Kova into text. It runs on your iPhone where it can; otherwise Apple processes the audio. The text goes only to your own Kova hub.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kova only opens your photo library if you choose to attach a photo, for example on a page from your Kova hub.
